trap.label: preposição em verbos de estudo
trap.wrong: This study compared about remote and office workers, according to the authors.
trap.right: This study compared remote and office workers, according to the authors.
trap.why: Em português “comparou sobre” é raro, mas o brasileiro acrescenta preposição por analogia com “falar de”. Em inglês compare, examine, report são transitivos diretos.

fix.wrong: Remote staff reports less stress last year.
fix.right: Remote staff reported less stress last year.
According to the authors, it works.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva no passado: “Remote staff report less stress.”
Reescreva sem preposição: “The authors examined about the results.”
Use according to: “The authors say it helps.”
rewrite.answer: According to the authors, it helps.
